name: knowledge-work-plugins
description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
one_liner: A set of ready-made AI 'employees', each one pre-trained on how a specific job (sales, HR, finance) is actually done, that plug into a company's own tools like Slack and Notion.
buyer: An operations lead at a mid-size company who wants their team using AI consistently instead of everyone prompting differently.
business_use_cases: An agency customizes the sales plugin with a client's own playbook and connectors, then resells it as a done-for-you AI SDR setup.
An HR consultancy adapts the productivity/HR plugin to a client's specific policies as a paid implementation package.
A company standardizes its whole team on one customized plugin so every employee gets consistent output instead of ad hoc prompting.

money_ideas.idea: Sell white-glove customization and connector setup for a specific plugin per client
Offer an ongoing 'plugin maintenance' retainer that keeps the customization current as the client's processes change

steal_this: This weekend, pick one plugin (e.g. sales), customize it heavily for one local business's actual workflow, and pitch it as a fixed-price implementation.
